review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary The Systems Administrator plays a critical role in supporting the technology that powers hotel operations across the Driftwood Hospitality Management portfolio. Reporting to the Director of IT, this position is responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, and upgrade of a wide range of property and corporate systems. The Systems Administrator works closely with property leadership, the IT Help Desk, brand technology teams, and third-party vendors to deliver reliable,
eligibility_evidence: Provide remote and on-site support to property associates and leadership, and deliver training on new or upgraded systems.
Work is performed at the corporate office, remotely, and on-site at hotel properties.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Three or more years of experience in systems or network administration. Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Windows operating systems and Windows Server, including Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP. Working knowledge of PCI DSS requirements. Physical Requirements & Work Environment Ability to lift and carry equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
